definitions.full: H7900. sok [ שׂךְ ] noun [masculine] booth, pavilion ( ׳שׂ perhaps erroneous, compare סֻכָּה סֹךְ, below II. סכך ); — suffix שֻׂכּוֺ Lam 2:6 his [ ׳י 's] pavilion (|| מֹעֲדוֺ ).
